about.text: Line of ultra-filtered organic milk from the US farmer cooperative Organic Valley, launched on 22 July 2019 as the first organic ultra-filtered milk in the US. It has about 50 % more protein and 50 % less sugar than ordinary milk and is lactose-free.

links.name: DairyReporter: Organic Valley debuts new Ultra filtered milk

how.text: Milk is run through a membrane that keeps protein and calcium and lets sugar and water pass, then lactase breaks down the lactose that is left. No membrane type or temperature is published.
